name: Gnoll Infestation
summary: Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar asks you to drive back gnolls in the hills to the southwest. Their presence disrupts trade and travel, though Twilight's encroachment has reduced their numbers.

sections.title: Gnolls in the Hills
sections.body: With their numbers diminished by Twilight's encroachment, Redridge gnolls still trouble the hills southwest of Rog'mar. Neza Bloodsnout asks you to clear a path for allies by removing the threat. Trade and travelers remain disrupted while the gnolls hold their ground.

faq.q: Why are the gnolls a problem?
faq.answer: The gnolls in the hills southwest of Rog'mar disrupt trade and trouble travelers.
They infest the hills to the southwest.

faq.q: Who asks me to deal with them?
faq.answer: Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar asks you to remove the gnoll threat.
Yes. Their presence has dwindled with Twilight's encroachment, but the threat remains.

faq.q: What kinds of gnolls are there?
faq.answer: The gnolls named are Redridge Mystics, Redridge Trappers, and Redridge Brutes.
